mentions.name: Sandustry
mentions.description: An automation game and factory builder with "falling sand" physics, blending falling-sand simulation with factory automation gameplay (described as Noita meets Factorio), prepared for release on Steam.
mentions.source_excerpt:
The final stretch of getting my game ready for release next week: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2764460/Sandustry/

It's an automation game and factory builder with "falling sand" physics. Think Noita meets Factorio.
